Nadia (Capacity): Quick internal note 1: were opening a limited soft-open for the new Omega-GPUs (omega-v1) next week. Regions: SEA-1 (ap-southeast-3) and BOS-2 (us-east-bos). Summary + action items below.
DeployBot: Maintenance window created: 2026-09-09 01:30-04:30 UTC for kernel preload, nvlink warmup, and telemetry hooks.
Nadia (Capacity): Short TL;DR: Omega-GPU trades very high memory bandwidth and improved tensor cores for long-context and heavy batching. Internal perf: ~1.9x token throughput on long seqs vs h200 and solid p99 stability for batched reranks.
Rory (Product): Trial pricing / reservation sizing?
Nadia (Capacity): Trial pricing: reserved trial $3.75/hr per GPU, burst $2.95/hr. Min reservation 2 GPUs; micro-reservations allowed in micro-pool slices (1 GPU) for burst only. Per-customer beta cap: 96 GPUs. No SLA change during soft-open.
Ethan (Infra): Runtime recommendations: set `--kv-cache=on`, `--quant-profile=omega_mixed`, and `--max-batch-size=64` for rerank workloads. For chat, recommend `max_batch_size=32` and `latency_bias=true`. Preload kernels will help first-30min stability.
Support Lead: Any notable policy changes?
Nadia (Capacity): Two small policy tweaks for the soft-open: 1) cancellation window shortened to 3 hours for trial reserved blocks to enable rapid pool rebalancing; 2) preemptible fallback disabled by default for omega-v1 (can opt-in per-reservation with `--preemptible=true`). Billing remains unchanged.
Ethan (Infra): Pilot incident note: during early pilot in SEA-1 we observed elevated nvlink error counters on a subset of hosts during aggressive kernel preloads; cause traced to an outdated driver on a vendor ROM. Mitigation: rolled vendor ROM, applied a dynamic nvlink backoff, and quarantined 4 hosts for deeper validation. Total customer-facing impact: none.
Rory (Product): Migration guidance for customers on older reserved pools?
Nadia (Capacity): Recommended migration path: 1) Create a small canary (5-10% traffic) for 24-48 hrs. 2) Use Console routing policies to set `fallback: stable-dedicated` or explicit region fallback. 3) Tag reservations with `omega-beta` so we can attach perf telemetry. Example CLI: `redwoodctl reservations create --pool omega-sea-1 --gpus 8 --term 168h --tags "omega-beta,canary"`.
Eng Runtime: Oncall watchlist: monitor `nvlink-err`, `egress-bw`, and `oom-model` traces. If p99 latency >2x baseline, flip routing to the fallback pool immediately.
Support Lead: Please prepare a short FAQ blurb and support template.
Nadia (Capacity): Blurb draft for docs: "Omega-GPU (beta): high-bandwidth dedicated GPUs tuned for long-context inference and large-batch reranking. Beta pricing and limited regional windows apply. Contact Support to request early access and migration help."
DeployBot: Note: quota bumps for `omega-beta` tagged reservations will be auto-issued; expect confirmation email within 2 hours of reservation creation.
Nadia (Capacity): Action items: @eng-runtime 1 validate top 10 customer models on omega kernels; @support prepare email template and FAQ; @sales flag customers in AP/US East for outreach. React with :white_check_mark: when you own an item. Keeping this thread for live updates during the soft-open.
